_doc: Regression-gate baseline for design-host/evals/gate.mjs. Deterministic targets graded with no LLM (adapted from Arta's evals/thresholds.json — Layer-B suite/handoff/builder-loop sections dropped as out of scope). grade.mjs reads a FLAT design/ root (config.json/theme.css/screens/*.tsx/components/*.tsx — no proto/ prefix). A3_interactivity runs only when config.json exists; both fixtures ship a config.json so A3 is graded (and passes) in both. A5 runs the vendored JSX-aware slop detector (slop-detect.mjs detectSlopJsx) in-process — no npx/network/install.

targets.note: A clean flat design/ tree — real @theme token set, 2 screens, a shared TopNav imported by both, config.json wiring nav. Must stay a full pass on all six assertions.

Deliberately bad — 2 near-identical screens, a 2-colour theme.css, raw inline hex everywhere, a gradient-text headline, a lone unshared component, and a real TSX parse error in two.tsx. Guards the grader against silently going permissive. Nav between the two screens is intentionally WORKING (real <Link>) so A3_interactivity stays a clean pass on purpose — the fixture's job is to prove the OTHER five checks still discriminate.
